title: *BUTTERY* MIDDLE EASTERN COOKIES FILLED WITH DATES 💁🏻‍♂️ KAAK BI AJWA RECIPE
description:
Travelling the world, one cookie at a time🌍🍪
Cookies From Around The World 🧳 Episode 5: Palestine 🇵🇸
Today we are making Kaak bi Ajwa, a delicate Middle Eastern cookie filled with luscious dates😎Buttery, crumbly with a sweet centre, it is a cookie that feels like comfort in every bite🥰

Ingredients
1 cup all purpose flour
½ cup fine semolina
2 tbsp white sesame seeds
2 tbsp fennel seeds powder
1 tbsp nigella seeds (kalonji)
Pinch of baking soda
½ cup olive oil
6 tbsp warm water + pinch of yeast
7-8 Medjool dates
¼ tsp cinnamon powder

Instructions
1. In a bowl, add the all purpose flour, semolina, white sesame seeds, fennel seeds powder, nigella seeds, baking soda and give it a mix.
2. Mix in the oil and the yeast mixed with warm water.
3. Knead the dough with a spatula or your hands till well combined.
4. In another bowl, add the deseeded Medjool dates and soak them in hot water for 5-10 minutes.
5. Now, strain the water and blend the dates with the cinnamon powder.
6. Transfer the ajwa (dates paste) to a piping bag and keep aside.
7. Divide the dough into equal portions. Flatten it to form a rectangular shape and pipe the dates paste in the centre.
8. Now, roll the dough and seal the ends. Once a long shape is formed, roll it gently with your palms to stretch it a bit more.
9. Once the dough has stretched, bring the ends together and seal them tightly, forming a circular shape with a hole in the centre like a bagel/donut.
10. Place them on a baking tray lined with parchment paper and bake in a preheated 180°C oven for 12-15 minutes or until the cookies are completely baked.
11. Serve warm with tea/coffee and enjoy.
